title: Evaluated done preflights acceptance readiness before any capture and keeps the transactional final recheck
outcome: Evaluated done preflights acceptance readiness before any capture and keeps the transactional final recheck
acceptance: a done on a fresh passing evaluation still records its capture evidence and checkpoint and seals, and the recovery receipts keep their typed causes and remedies

under an evaluated policy, a done with a nonempty summary and no evaluation is refused MissingAcceptanceEvaluation with the run evidence set, the latest checkpoint, and the run feed head unchanged apart from the pending protocol attempt; a done on a failing evaluation is refused AcceptanceFailed the same way; the preflight uses the shared readiness assessment and the storage completion keeps its transactional final recheck

completion.summary: The service completion preflights acceptance readiness before prepare_completion_evidence through acceptance_evaluation_recovery_cause (shared assess_on + blocking_cause) and returns the same typed recovery result the storage path returns via work_completion_recovery, whose guard now admits the acceptance causes with the bound-revision criterion check; the storage completion keeps its transactional recheck. Pinned by evaluate_records_under_policy_and_completion_consumes_it with state snapshots around both refusals and the unchanged fresh-pass control (RED logs/25, GREEN logs/26).
